meta.style: 3D render, soft studio lighting, transparent background
meta.status: ASSETS PRESENT, IN USE — not yet an Approved Component
meta.$comment_status: The owner pasted the four PNGs into this folder by hand on 2026-08-14. They were opened, checked, normalised to lowercase filenames, and re-encoded to 288px WebP under web/ for embedding. All four are live as page headers in the two settings prototypes and were verified in-browser. They still do NOT have a row in .claude/rules/design-system.md Approved Components: that gate is the owner's to clear, and the palette conflicts flagged on appearance and notifications below are still open.
meta.$comment_size: Owner calls 2026-08-14: 96 -> 77 -> 62, two 0.8x steps on the same day. At 96 and again at 77 the render read as too heavy against a 29px title. Assets stay 288px, so 62 is still well over 3x and loses no sharpness. The number lives once, in design.tokens.js layout.iconHeaderSize, which _kit.py's ICON_PX and the Vercel dashboard's 3D-icons folder both read.
meta.$comment_usage: One per L2 inner page, in the page header, and essentially nowhere else. Never a row icon — tier 2 (flat monoline) owns everything inside a list.

icons.conflict: ⚠ Palette imagery pulls in blue, red, yellow, brown paint colours that are outside the 2026-08-12 palette rule (white, grey, the two greens only). That rule governs the PRODUCT's own surfaces, not necessarily a photographic/3D icon rendering a real-world object — but flagging rather than assuming, since it's the kind of thing that's been an explicit owner call every other time it came up (see design.tokens.js LAW 2 and the device-thumbnail/avatar compromises in build-profile-settings.py).
